name: autosuggest-field
title: Autosuggest field
description: A free-text field with suggestions: type a job title or a city and pick a match, or keep exactly what you typed.
docs: The value is whatever is in the field: onValueChange receives every keystroke and the suggestion a click or Enter fills in, and value, defaultValue and onValueChange control it. options are texts or { value, hint } with a quiet word beside the text (a country beside a city). They are ranked by what begins with the typed text, then a word that begins with it (designer finds Product Designer), then what only contains it, ignoring capitals and accents, with the match in bold (a single suggestion that is exactly what was typed is not offered again, but one that only differs in capitals or accents is: zurich offers Zürich), and the first maxOptions (6) are shown; with an empty field ArrowDown lists the first ones as they are. ArrowDown opens the list and ArrowDown, ArrowUp move a highlight that aria-activedescendant names while the focus stays in the input. Enter takes the highlighted suggestion; with none highlighted it leaves the text and the form around the field submits as usual. Escape closes the list and keeps the text. onQueryChange(query) fires as the text is typed, so a server can answer with new options; add loading for a spinner and a quiet line while there is nothing to list yet, filter={false} when your source has already narrowed the list, and emptyHint for a line that says nothing matched (without it the panel stays shut). The number of suggestions is announced politely. placement keeps the list under or over the field instead of letting it flip, defaultOpen starts with it open. Other input props such as name, id and placeholder go to the input. rankSuggestions is exported from autosuggest-field/suggestions.
